briefdescription.para: Base class for non-instruction debug metadata records that have positions within IR.

detaileddescription.para: Features various methods copied across from the Instruction class to aid ease-of-use. DbgRecords should always be linked into a DbgMarker's StoredDbgRecords list. The marker connects a DbgRecord back to its position in the BasicBlock.

We need a discriminator for dyn/isa casts.
